::: {.news-header}
# Cancellation policy

Cancellation terms for each of our programmes.
:::

## Granada: Spanish and Local Life {#sle}

- Participants must confirm their enrolment with La Placeta Granada by **15 February 2027** by signing the enrolment contract and paying 50% of the total programme fee.
- If a participant cancels, the following cancellation fees will apply:

| Date of cancellation | Cancellation fee |
|---|---|
| Before 15 February 2027 | Full refund |
| 15 February to 28 February 2027 | 25% of the total programme fee |
| 1 March to 15 March 2027 | 50% of the total programme fee |
| 16 March 2027 or later | 100% of the total programme fee |

For any questions about cancellations, please contact us at [info@laplacetagranada.com](mailto:info@laplacetagranada.com).
